# All Obey Jesus (John 14:15)

## Emotional Focus
The happy life of listening to and obeying Jesus every day.

## Key KJV
“If ye love me, keep my commandments.” (John 14:15)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus said if we love Him we will obey what He says. When we listen and obey, our hearts stay close to Him and full of peace.

## Coloring Prompt
Happy children walking hand-in-hand with Jesus on a peaceful path.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Obeying Jesus is how we show we love Him.”
